title: Hair Straightener – Keratin Ceramic & Scalp Massager | Calm & Curl
description:
Transform your hair with the advanced Hair Straightener from Calm & Curl, designed to give you salon-smooth, frizz-free results right at home. This innovative styling tool combines efficient hair straightening with a unique scalp massaging feature, ensuring a comfortable and luxurious experience. Say goodbye to dull, unruly hair and embrace sleek, shiny locks with minimal heat damage. Perfect for everyday styling, this hair straightener is a must-have for anyone seeking professional results effortlessly.

Key features

  • Keratin Infused Ceramic Coating: Experience superior glide and even heat distribution for shiny, smooth, and frizz-free hair, protecting each strand from excessive heat.
  • Triple Bristle Design: Gently detangles and straightens your hair while providing a soothing massage to your scalp, enhancing blood circulation and relaxation.
  • Rapid Heat-Up Time: Get ready to style in just 50 seconds, making your morning routine quicker and more efficient.
  • Adjustable Temperature Control: Easily set the ideal temperature for your hair type with convenient adjustment buttons, preventing overheating and ensuring optimal styling.
  • 1.8-Meter Swivel Cord: Enjoy maximum flexibility and tangle-free operation with a long, rotating power cord, perfect for styling from any angle.
  • Seroprotect Technology: Maintains a consistent temperature across the brush, safeguarding your hair from potential heat damage and ensuring uniform results.

Materials & care

The outer casing of this hair straightener is crafted from durable, high-quality plastic, ensuring longevity and a lightweight design. To maintain your hair straightener, ensure it is unplugged and completely cool before cleaning. Gently wipe the ceramic plates and exterior casing with a soft, dry, or slightly damp cloth. Do not use harsh chemicals or abrasive cleaners. Store in a cool, dry place.

FAQ

How quickly does this hair straightener heat up?
The Calm & Curl Hair Straightener features a rapid heat-up time, ready to use in just 50 seconds for quick styling.
Is it safe to use daily?
Yes, with its Keratin Infused Ceramic Coating and Seroprotect Technology, this hair straightener minimizes heat damage, making it suitable for regular use. Always use the appropriate temperature setting for your hair type.
Does it help with frizz?
Absolutely! The keratin-infused ceramic plates are specifically designed to deliver shiny, smooth, and frizz-free hair with every pass.
What is the cord length?
It comes with a generous 1.8-meter swivel cord, providing ample reach and flexibility during styling.
Can I adjust the temperature?
Yes, the hair straightener includes temperature adjustment buttons, allowing you to customize the heat setting according to your hair’s needs.
